subject: Acme: governance & procurement joining — planning request for demo + workshop
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Troy Walker <troy.walker@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thu 10am PT?

Thanks for the invite, Soojin. We want to loop in a couple more folks on our side before the demo: our CISO (Troy) and procurement. Also, heads up — our Head of Platform (Maria V.) will be traveling the week of the 7th and won't be available for a short slot. Would it be possible to move the session and make it a 60–90 minute run-through so we can cover security controls, deployment options, and procurement/contract questions?

If you can share a slightly longer agenda and a few alternative dates/times that accommodate our security and procurement folks that would help.

– Maria

--
Maria Gomez
Director, Cloud Engineering
Acme Corporation
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Troy Walker <troy.walker@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thu 10am PT?

Hi Maria — appreciate the heads-up and totally fine with expanding the session. Quick notes: 1) We usually run a 45-minute product demo + 30–45 minute security + procurement deep-dive when governance teams join, so 90 minutes is sensible. 2) We can split into a demo + breakout (security/procurement) if that helps attendees skip portions.

I attached a proposed agenda (lightweight) and an .ics with three alternate windows. Can you confirm who on your side needs the deep-dive and whether they prefer morning or afternoon PT?

Proposed options (all PT):
- Tue Jun 15, 10:30–12:00
- Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Jun 24, 09:00–10:30

If those don't work, tell us a range and we'll pull more. Aditya and Karthik from our side will cover architecture + deployment patterns; Neha will handle security controls/compliance.

Thanks —
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Att: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, proposed-times.ics
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>, Troy Walker <troy.walker@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thu 10am PT?

Looping internal folks — Maria, thanks for the context. Two quick internal constraints to flag: 1) Karthik is on travel Jun 14–18 (partial availability) and requests morning slots only on the 15th; 2) our usual security prep requires access to an architecture diagram and a short pre-demo questionnaire (we can do that asynchronously).

If platform leadership is traveling the week of the 7th, I think Jun 24 (Thu 09:00–10:30 PT) is the safest single-session option so we have everyone present. Alternatively we can do the demo on Jun 15 (10:30–12:00) but split 45/45 with the governance folks joining the second half if Maria V. is unavailable for the first half.

I can take the first 30 minutes on architecture and hand off to Karthik for deployment patterns. Neha — can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts we should share ahead of time to keep the procurement conversation efficient?

- Aditya
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>, Troy Walker <troy.walker@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thu 10am PT?

Happy to own the pre-demo security packet. I'll prepare: 1) SOC 2 Type II scope summary (redacted), 2) data retention and encryption snippets, 3) our private deployment checklist. I can share those as a PDF link by EOD Friday (Jun 5).

For timing: Jun 24 (09:00–10:30 PT) works for me and keeps Karthik back from travel conflicts. If you prefer the split model on Jun 15, I can join the second half.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Troy Walker <troy.walker@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, Maria V <maria.v@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thu 10am PT?

Thanks, team — Jun 24 09:00–10:30 PT works for everyone on our side. We appreciate the security packet in advance; that should help procurement prepare their questions. Could you also include a short slide on private deployment/networking options and an outline of our procurement next steps (timelines, contract owner at Redwood, and sample SOW items)?

I'll accept the invite and add our CISO (Troy), Head of Platform (Maria V.), and procurement alias. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Maria

--
Maria Gomez
Director, Cloud Engineering
Acme Corporation
